narrative: HUIZ ranked first in this range, up 22 percent from the prior close, with our research reaching no conclusion. XLAB was up 89 percent from the prior close, with recent news in our sources: an 8-K reported entry into a material definitive agreement with Sunon, while secondary coverage reported a sale of 12 Nvidia HGX B300 GPU servers and 36 months of IT operating services for $8.2 million. XLAB was up 11.7% since the previous checkpoint. Of the 12 names the desk covers, 4 had recent news in our sources.
